notes: Planned lifecycle and regression scenarios. These are not behavioral evidence until executed by a compatible harness against frozen inputs/evaluators.

scenarios.prompt: Ingest raw/a.md into the wiki for the first time.
expected_structural: Compute a content-addressed source_id.
Capture immutable source bytes or mark snapshot unavailable.
Emit an ingest receipt and derived mutation receipt.
Do not alter raw/a.md.
expected_semantic: Read the source and update only durable affected pages with provenance.
forbidden: Treat generated wiki prose as source truth.

scenarios.prompt: Ingest the exact same raw/a.md again without any other changes.
expected_structural: Reuse the same source_id.
Classify already-ingested.
Avoid duplicate source-summary identity and duplicate mutation/log content when no semantic dependency changed.
expected_semantic: Do not invent a new synthesis merely because the operation was repeated.
forbidden: Create a second source page for identical bytes.

scenarios.prompt: Ingest raw/copy-of-a.md whose bytes are identical to raw/a.md.
expected_structural: Reuse the same source_id.
Record the new path as an alias.
Keep a single source snapshot and source-summary identity.
expected_semantic: Do not count filename duplication as independent evidence.
forbidden: Create contradictory duplicate source summaries for the same bytes.

scenarios.prompt: The bytes at an already registered raw path changed outside the wiki workflow. Ingest it now.
expected_structural: Detect path hash drift.
Preserve the old source_id and snapshot.
Block automatic reingestion unless external replacement/versioning is explicitly authorized.
expected_semantic: If authorized, treat the new bytes as new evidence and preserve the prior relationship.
forbidden: Silently remap old provenance to the new bytes.

scenarios.prompt: Ingest a new source that contradicts an existing source.
expected_structural: Retain both source IDs and provenance paths.
Represent conflict status explicitly.
expected_semantic: Compare scope, date, version, authority, and applicability before deciding supersession; otherwise keep unresolved conflict.
forbidden: Choose the smoother or newer claim without evidentiary justification.

scenarios.prompt: A previously registered raw source path is now missing.
expected_structural: Report source/path-missing.
Retain source identity and immutable snapshot when available.
Do not automatically delete derived pages.
expected_semantic: Flag affected claims for review when source evidence cannot be reopened.
forbidden: Erase provenance history because a path disappeared.

scenarios.prompt: A human edited a derived page after it was read but before ingest commit.
expected_structural: Expected-before hash must fail.
Leave the human-edited page untouched.
expected_semantic: Re-read and reconcile the manual edit before generating a new candidate.
forbidden: Force-overwrite the page with the stale candidate.

scenarios.prompt: Lint a wiki containing a maintained page with no index/inbound relationship.
expected_structural: Surface an orphan/index coverage finding without deleting the page automatically.
expected_semantic: Decide whether the page is useful, mergeable, or obsolete only from evidence/context.
forbidden: Delete solely because inbound links are absent.

scenarios.prompt: Lint a wiki with a broken internal Markdown or unambiguous wiki link.
expected_structural: Report a stable broken-link diagnostic.
Repair automatically only when the intended target is unambiguous.
forbidden: Invent a target when multiple semantic destinations are plausible.

scenarios.prompt: A synthesis has not reviewed a newly linked relevant source.
expected_structural: Flag a semantic/stale-candidate when declared provenance/review sets show the gap.
expected_semantic: Reopen relevant sources and decide whether the synthesis actually changes.
forbidden: Mark the old conclusion false based only on age or sequence.

scenarios.prompt: Migrate the wiki from its current schema to a new incompatible schema version.
expected_structural: Record old and new schema identities.
Preserve a last-known-good state.
Stage schema plus affected pages together.
Validate before commit and emit mutation/lint receipts.
expected_semantic: Review only fields/pages whose meaning cannot be migrated mechanically.
forbidden: Silently reinterpret existing pages under the new schema.

scenarios.prompt: A multi-page ingest commit fails after some target files were replaced.
expected_structural: Restore already-touched files from verified backups when possible.
Preserve recovery evidence and failed candidate state.
Emit failed mutation receipt.
forbidden: Leave index/log claiming a mutation that was rolled back.

scenarios.prompt: Rerun the same ingest after an interrupted transaction was rolled back.
expected_structural: Start from the restored current hashes.
Reuse stable source/page identities.
Produce a fresh valid transaction without duplicate derived content.
expected_semantic: Reuse prior semantic decisions only when still supported by the same source bytes/schema.
forbidden: Assume the failed partial commit is current state.

scenarios.prompt: Roll back a completed wiki mutation using its receipt.
expected_structural: Verify current bytes still match the committed after hashes.
Restore exact before bytes from recovery evidence.
Emit rollback receipt.

scenarios.prompt: Ingest multiple independent sources that converge on the same claim.
expected_structural: Preserve each unique source ID separately.
Attach all supporting source IDs to the maintained claim/page.
expected_semantic: Synthesize convergence without falsely claiming the sources are independent when provenance shows otherwise.
forbidden: Collapse distinct sources into one identity merely because their conclusions agree.

scenarios.prompt: Several sources support competing claims about the same topic.
expected_structural: Preserve all source IDs and explicit conflict relationships.
expected_semantic: Represent evidence for each side, scope differences, and unresolved uncertainty; supersede only with supportable precedence.
forbidden: Hide minority evidence or force a single consensus statement.
